meta.method: Exhaustive search over the 10 study sites for k = 1..3 (every building weighted 1) on the delivered light-vehicle times. The picks are nested, so each crew's gain is the buildings it adds to the previous step.
limits: Estimated road travel times, not response times.
Alta/Media/Baja is the team's priority class (REGLAS_prioridad.md), not an official risk map.
Buildings with no route (t_today_min null) count as not covered.
